## Purpose

Turn a completed `matter_render` capture into the durable identities an
object-loop receipt needs. Copies each captured view's image and the capture
receipt out of the transient `runs/<job>/capture` tree into the
content-addressed store at `{data_dir}/artifacts/objects`, named by its own
SHA-256, and refuses any member whose bytes no longer match the digest the
completion receipt recorded. Also mints the candidate artifact, whose digest is
the declared `candidate_sha256`, and returns the render profile recorded on the
immutable result.

The digest is the identity, so retention is idempotent: a second run yields the
same `artifact://` URIs and rewrites nothing. It never measures an image —
`Capture.ready`, `Capture.decoded` and the per-view metrics are the external
scorer's, and this command reports pointers and digests only.

See [the object-loop guide](../../guides/object-loop.md) for the runbook that
takes a finished render to a startable loop.

The command delegates to `JobCommandsMixin` in
[`src/commands/job_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/job_commands.py).
Retained objects survive job cleanup and daemon restart under the configured data
directory; the per-view identity planes and the adapter's own transcript stay
behind `aq job logs` unless `--include-channels` asks for them.
